name: loc_interest_8_months
title: Line Of Credit Interest Estimate
prompt: Read loan_terms.txt and balance_schedule.csv. Compute total LOC interest for every schedule row using the formula in loan_terms.txt. Report the summed interest rounded to 2 decimals (not a balance).

loan_terms.txt: Each month: interest = balance * APR_decimal * days / 365
Sum months 1..8 and round to 2 decimals.
README.md: In run_lua use FILES['balance_schedule.csv'] — io.open on disk paths will not see these files.
Skip the CSV header. Do not submit a balance like 5100.
